entries.title: Tropico

emulation.notes: Use the Windows PC release with compatibility fixes if needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation for a 2001 city-builder.

primary.version: Tropico Reloaded / Mucho Macho Edition route
primary.why: The Windows PC route is the best current way to play the original Tropico with Paradise Island included through bundle/re-release paths. The Mac OS X release is valid historically, but PC has the clearest current storefront and compatibility route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Tropico Reloaded on Windows PC through Steam or GOG for the original game, Paradise Island, and Tropico 2 in one package.

entries.remaster_caveats: Paradise Island is expansion content for the original Tropico. Tropico Reloaded is a bundle, not a separate sequel.

entries.title: Tropico 2: Pirate Cove
entries.definitive_edition: Tropico 2: Pirate Cove on Windows PC through Tropico Reloaded

emulation.notes: Use the Windows PC release with compatibility fixes if needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation for a 2003 city-builder.

primary.version: Tropico Reloaded / current PC bundle route
primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best current route because Tropico 2 is sold in Tropico Reloaded and has the clearest compatibility/capture path. The Mac release is historically valid but not the best current recommendation.
primary.how_to_play: Play Tropico 2 through Tropico Reloaded on Windows PC via Steam or GOG, using compatibility fixes if needed.

entries.remaster_caveats: Tropico 2 is included in Tropico Reloaded as a bundle component, not as a remaster.

entries.title: Tropico 3
entries.definitive_edition: Tropico 3: Gold Edition on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC Gold Edition; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC Gold Edition is the best route because it includes the Absolute Power expansion and has the best capture/compatibility path. Xbox 360, macOS, iOS/iPadOS, and Android are valid access routes but do not add sourced exclusive content over PC.
primary.how_to_play: Play Tropico 3: Gold Edition on Windows PC through Steam or GOG for the base game plus Absolute Power.

entries.remaster_caveats: Absolute Power is expansion content, not a separate mainline game. Tropico Mobile is a mobile adaptation of Tropico 3, not a separate sequel.

entries.title: Tropico 4
entries.definitive_edition: Tropico 4 on Windows PC with Modern Times and DLC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.version: Tropico 4: Gold Edition / complete DLC route
primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best complete route because it has the Modern Times expansion and DLC path, with the strongest capture and compatibility support. Xbox 360 and macOS are valid routes but do not add sourced exclusive content over PC.
primary.how_to_play: Play Tropico 4 on Windows PC through Steam or GOG and add Modern Times plus DLC packs for the full content route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Modern Times and the smaller packs are DLC/expansion content, not separate mainline entries.

entries.title: Tropico 5
entries.definitive_edition: Tropico 5 on Windows PC with DLC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release if owned; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best route because it has the full DLC path, mouse/keyboard controls, and the strongest capture/compatibility support. macOS, Linux, Xbox 360, PS4, and Xbox One are valid access routes but do not add sourced exclusive gameplay content over PC.
primary.how_to_play: Play Tropico 5 on Windows PC if you already own it or through an available PC storefront route, and add the DLC packs for the complete content path.

entries.remaster_caveats: Tropico 5's Waterborne, Espionage, and smaller packs are DLC, not separate game entries. Tropico 5 was delisted on some storefronts, so ownership/access may vary.

entries.title: Tropico 6
entries.definitive_edition: Tropico 6 on Windows PC with DLC and ModKit support

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native modern PC presentation with ModKit support.

primary.version: Current PC release with DLC/mod route
primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best Tropico 6 route because it has the full DLC path, ModKit support, mouse/keyboard controls, and the best capture/settings flexibility. Next Gen Edition on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S is strong for consoles, but it does not add sourced exclusive gameplay content over PC.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC version through Steam, GOG, Epic, or Kalypso and add the DLC packs you want for the full content path.

entries.remaster_caveats: Next Gen Edition is a current-gen console edition, not a sequel. Tropico 6 DLC packs are not separate mainline game entries. Tropico 7 is announced but not added here until it has a released, sourced play route.
